summary: Phase 2 Finance Module Testing Complete - All backend and frontend tests passed. Finance module with 6 sub-modules (Kas Masuk, Kas Keluar, Invoice, Surat Masuk, Surat Keluar, Rekap Bulanan) fully functional. Auto-numbering, auto-creation from sparepart/payroll, and Rekap Bulanan Excavator form all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: All /api/finance/* endpoints require admin role (operator gets 403)
Backend: Kas Masuk CRUD with auto-numbering KM-TTP-xxx
Backend: Kas Keluar with jenis BK → BK-TTP-xxx, jenis KK → KK-TTP-xxx
Backend: Sparepart auto-creates BK kas keluar, cannot be edited/deleted directly, removed when sparepart deleted
Backend: Payroll auto-creates KK kas keluar (kasbon + gaji_bersih), cannot be edited/deleted directly, removed when payroll deleted
Backend: Surat Keluar auto-numbering SP/TTP/{seq}/{ROMAN}/{YEAR}, PATCH updates month/year but keeps seq
Backend: Invoice auto-numbering INV/TTP/{seq}/{ROMAN}/{YEAR}, PATCH updates month/year but keeps seq
Backend: GET /api/finance/summary returns correct structure with 12 months, keluar_bk, keluar_kk, totals
Backend: GET /api/reports/units returns new fields (tgl_hm_awal, tgl_hm_akhir, tgl_perpanjang_cars, status, lokasi_proyek, serial_number)
Frontend: Operator does NOT see Keuangan menu, redirected from /finance to /
Frontend: Admin sees Keuangan menu and can access /finance page
Frontend: All 7 Finance tabs render (dashboard, kas-masuk, kas-keluar, invoices, surat-masuk, surat-keluar, rekap)
Frontend: Kas Masuk table, export buttons (Excel, PDF), and Add button present
Frontend: Kas Keluar jenis filter buttons work (all, BK, KK)
Frontend: Rekap tab in Finance page with export buttons
Frontend: Laporan page has both tabs (unit & rekap)
Frontend: Rekap Bulanan table has 12+ columns with all required fields
Frontend: All rekap export buttons present (PDF, Excel, Word)
Frontend: Regression - All existing pages still load (Dashboard, Units, Operations, Payroll, Spareparts)
